rawContent: What does not belong, @glowgow? Glenn Thrush. U wrongly, unfairly list @GlennThrush in w/legit alleged sex offenders in ur Natalie P piece. His (non)crime? He made passes at peers at bars/parties & stopped when they said no. Pls try 2 do no harm 2 innocent ppl & #MeToo  movement

@pcbutnotpc @mashagessen & for that he should be lumped in w/those who allegedly committed true sex offenses? Lose his job? Scary! I see the (mis)treatment & mislabeling of @GlennThrush as the most troubling example of the wrong side of the legit side of the #MeToo  movement.

@pcbutnotpc "Purportedly bragged/lied"abt something that happens w men (& women) at parties/drinking/bars - tacky, dumb, awkward, maybe icky. Ok. Then he purportedly says it was the other one who did this awkward thing? Where r we going here? Nowhere healthy. Not a valid #Metoo, methinks!
